<!-- Generated by docs/scripts/generate.ts from the source code. Do not edit. -->

Each error of x18n has a code such as `X18N0001`. The CLI prints the code with why the error happened, a fix and a link to the page of the code. With `--json`, the error is in `errors` of the [envelope](/references/json-contracts), with a `docs` link to its page here.

The first digit is the group:

- `0`: config.
- `1`: plugins.
- `2`: finding and parsing locale files.
- `3`: scanning source files.
- `4`: edits.

| Code | Title | Exit code |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [X18N0001](/errors/x18n0001) | Invalid config | `2` |
| [X18N0002](/errors/x18n0002) | Config file could not be loaded | `2` |
| [X18N0003](/errors/x18n0003) | Unknown project | `2` |
| [X18N1001](/errors/x18n1001) | Plugin could not be loaded | `2` |
| [X18N1002](/errors/x18n1002) | Duplicate capability id | `2` |
| [X18N1003](/errors/x18n1003) | Unknown preset | `2` |
| [X18N1004](/errors/x18n1004) | Invalid YAML plugin | `2` |
| [X18N2001](/errors/x18n2001) | No format for resource | `1` |
| [X18N2002](/errors/x18n2002) | Resource could not be parsed | `1` |
| [X18N2003](/errors/x18n2003) | Resource is not an object of messages | `1` |
| [X18N2004](/errors/x18n2004) | Locale file is not static | `1` |
| [X18N3001](/errors/x18n3001) | Source file could not be scanned | `1` |
| [X18N4001](/errors/x18n4001) | Resource is read-only | `1` |
| [X18N4002](/errors/x18n4002) | Rename target already exists | `1` |
| [X18N4003](/errors/x18n4003) | A decision is needed | `3` |
| [X18N4004](/errors/x18n4004) | Plan is stale | `4` |
| [X18N4005](/errors/x18n4005) | No resource for the key | `1` |
| [X18N4006](/errors/x18n4006) | Key not found | `1` |
| [X18N4007](/errors/x18n4007) | Placeholder mismatch | `1` |
| [X18N4008](/errors/x18n4008) | Invalid edit input | `1` |
| [X18N5001](/errors/x18n5001) | Review file could not be read | `1` |
| [X18N5003](/errors/x18n5003) | Reviews are not available | `1` |
| [X18N5004](/errors/x18n5004) | Review not found | `1` |
| [X18N5005](/errors/x18n5005) | Not an open suggestion | `1` |
